messages:
ida: quickstart docker sample works on my laptop but our GH Actions job using REDWOOD_SERVICE_ACCOUNT now stalls and eventually fails with a 402. anyone familiar with this flow?

Tom: are you running the sample inside docker build or in the test runner container? we recently had a rotation where workspace SAs lost billing access if not re-linked.

ida: running `docker run -e REDWOOD_SERVICE_ACCOUNT=${{ secrets.REDWOOD_SERVICE_ACCOUNT }} sample-app` in the workflow. logs: `HTTP/1.1 402 Payment Required - {"error":"billing_required"}` then the node process keeps retrying for ~4m before exit.

yara: that sounds like the node SDK is treating 402 as retriable and backing off. do you have NODE_SDK_RETRY env set? default is 5 with exponential backoff.

ida: nope, not set explicitly. python tests in the same job fail fast with 402. node side is the one stalling.

sre-bot: Incident note: 2026-03-20 - several CI jobs stalled after service account rotation; root cause: billing flag unset for newly created service accounts.

Tom: short repro i ran locally: start sample-app container with a workspace-scoped SA without billing -> node client prints `billing_required` then logs `retrying auth` repeatedly. looks like a token-refresh loop triggered by 402.

ida: can we short-circuit that in CI? wasted build minutes are killing us.

devex-bot: suggestions: 1) attach billing to workspace or use a user-scoped API key for CI; 2) set NODE_SDK_RETRY=0 or NODE_SDK_MAX_RETRIES=0 as a stopgap; 3) patch: node-sdk v0.9.1 will treat 4xx billing errors as terminal. docs: https://redwood.example/docs/ci-auth-patterns

yara: i'm going to open a small PR to change retry classification for billing_required -> non-retriable and add a clearer error with workspace id + quick-link. also adding a note in the Docker quickstart that service accounts may require billing flags.

ida: applied the workaround (NODE_SDK_RETRY=0) in the workflow and job now fails fast with 402 so we can surface the billing step to the team. thanks.

Tom: we'll ship the SDK change tomorrow and add a changelog entry. also adding a CI checklist item to onboarding docs to prefer user keys for ephemeral pipelines.

ida: great — marking this resolved in our pipeline. :white_check_mark:

yara: filed CL: github.com/redwood/sdk/pull/412 - change retry logic + improve error text.

ida: cheers all!
